تكتشفي (form VIII)
# تَكْتَشِفِي (taktašifī) /tak.ta.ʃi.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# تُكْتَشَفِي (tuktašafī) /tuk.ta.ʃa.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
